snippet.title: Cloak And Coin - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Cloak And Coin offers 1-4 players the chaotic thrill of being thieves, just not particularly graceful ones. With a limited number of days to plan, finance and execute the greatest heist Marfit has ever seen.

Wishlist Cloak And Coin on Steam today: https://shorturl.at/Fcm35

Find out more the official Discord server: https://discord.gg/eD4zwj3Eb6

Track: "Castle Halls (Fantasy/Regal Orchestral)"
Artist: Matteo Palmer
